name: BOSSA LOUNGE
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless bossa nova from a small combo. Nylon guitar, brushes, upright bass, flute or vibes.
description: BOSSA LOUNGE turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a bossa nova combo that never stops. Each tune has its own title, key and form: nylon guitar comping in jazz voicings, brushed drums with a rim click on the clave, an upright bass on root and fifth, and a flute or vibraphone melody. Head, a solo chorus, head out, a soft tag ending, then the next tune. A reel-to-reel turns on the screen under a neon martini glass, with two VU meters and the chord. Fourteen styles, from fast samba to slow ballads; knobs for tempo, feel, mood and melody.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
